description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the percentage of matched versus not matched responses for six different logical reasoning categories, with each category represented by a single bar divided into two colored segments: blue for “Matched” and light blue for “Not Matched,” as indicated by the legend. The vertical axis lists the categories in descending order of their total percentage: “No Hallucination” (1.67%), “Oriented” (2.67%), “Active” (3.00%), “Self-aware” (6.90%), “Rigorous” (4.67%), and “Correct” (1.00%). The horizontal axis represents percentage values on a linear scale from 0% to 100%, with tick marks at every 20 percentage points. The “No Hallucination” category has the longest bar, reaching 1.67%, composed of a blue segment labeled “97.33%” and a light blue segment labeled “1.67%”. The “Oriented” category shows a bar of 2.67%, with a blue segment of “97.33%” and a light blue segment of “2.67%”. The “Active” category has a bar of 3.00%, with a blue segment of “97.00%” and a light blue segment of “3.00%”. The “Self-aware” category shows a bar of 6.90%, with a blue segment of “94.00%” and a light blue segment of “6.90%”. The “Rigorous” category has a bar of 4.67%, with a blue segment of “95.33%” and a light blue segment of “4.67%”. The “Correct” category has the shortest bar at 1.00%, composed of a blue segment labeled “99.00%” and a light blue segment labeled “1.00%”. All bars are presented without any sorting or visual emphasis beyond their standard presentation.
